scripts.title: Soul Bound Free Early Acces
scripts.features:
As a result, I discovered that you can grant yourself free early access. It's FE, has no server checks, etc., and remains in place even if you switch servers or exit the game. You will have access to early access if you run the script and then rejoin.

Feel free to deobfuscate the code; it's easy lol. Also, join my Discord server for more scripts I made.
